name: Fateful Shot (Grit)
body:
Prerequisite(s): grit class feature or Amateur Gunslinger feat

Benefit(s): When you miss an attack roll against a creature, you may spend a point of grit to have the shot ricochet wildly. Ultimately, this wild ricochet hits something the intended target cared about, causing the intended target physiological distress of some kind. It could hit the intended target’s wife, friend, lover, child, valuable ally, an innocent bystander (if the intended target was good), or an unattended object that the original target cares about. Anything that could be hit, can be hit by this shot as long as it is within range of the firearm even if it means ignoring line of sight, line of effect, cover and concealment. Only impossible targets are impossible to hit (such as a creature inside a prismatic sphere).
